title: Cam Ward, Jeffery Simmons, Morgan Cox return as Titans captains

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Cam Ward, Jeffery Simmons, Morgan Cox return as Titans captains
sources.description: The days leading up to the start of the 2026 season have seen most teams name their captains and one trend around the league has been an expanded number of players wearing "C" on their jerseys.
